summary: Adds a new monthly quota metrics.max_datapoints_monthly (default unlimited): OTLP metrics ingestion (POST /v1/otlp/metrics) now checks the org's datapoint quota and answers 429 when over it (logs/spans unaffected); shown on the Usage page as 'Metric datapoints (this month)'.

statements.why: Default limit null (registry.ts:147) so nothing is blocked until a limit is set; check runs inside the already API-key-authenticated ingest route.

statements.text: • The agent changed CHANGELOG.md, a notes file (not code).
statements.why: True, but it's the only change described; the real quota change is not mentioned.

statements.text: ◐ Type checking is turned off in 1 spot in packages/backend/src/modules/otlp/metric-routes.ts (`any`).
◐ Type checking is turned off in 3 spots in packages/backend/src/tests/modules/capabilities/ingestion-quota.test.ts (`any`).
statements.why: Three `any` in the new test file; test-only, irrelevant to an owner.

misses.what: New monthly cap on metric datapoints per organization: once set (entitlements/admin API/CAPABILITY_DEFAULTS_JSON) and exceeded, metrics sent by customers' OpenTelemetry collectors are rejected with 429 while logs and traces keep flowing; it appears on the Usage page.
